issues.description: package_info() uses the Conan 1.x `self.env_info.OCAMLPATH.append(...)` API. In Conan 2.x this attribute is a MockInfoProperty (conan/internal/model/cpp_info.py; verified present in develop2 and released v2.33.0) whose __getattr__ returns an ephemeral [] and only records a 'Usage of deprecated Conan 1.X features' warning, so the OCAMLPATH export is a silent no-op and the comment at conanfile.py:155 ('OCaml consumers (dune/ocamlc) locate the library via OCAMLPATH') does not hold. test.sh:12 masks this by exporting OCAMLPATH itself, so the claimed passing tests are not fake, but downstream consumers get no environment propagation.
issues.fix_suggestion: Replace with the Conan 2.x mechanism, e.g. `self.runenv_info.define_path("OCAMLPATH", os.path.join(self.package_folder, "lib", "ocaml"))` (and/or self.buildenv_info), per the 'Conan 2.x API' rule.

issues.description: Method order deviates from the mandated sequence export_sources -> requirements -> layout -> source -> generate -> build -> package -> package_info: `requirements()` (line 48) and `layout()` (line 55) precede `export_sources()` (line 59).

Script opens with `set -eu` instead of the mandatory `set -euo pipefail` required by shell-script rule 7. No pipelines are used in the script, so the practical impact is nil, but the convention is not followed.

The R51 evidence text says the v1.2.1 tarball 'contains only src/ (ppx_derivers.ml/.mli), pkg/pkg.ml (topkg) and dune metadata'. The upstream 1.2.1 tree (verified via the GitHub tag tree) additionally contains Makefile (300 B), ppx_derivers.opam, CHANGES.md, LICENSE.md, README.md and .gitignore. notes.md:30 repeats the same 'only' enumeration while notes.md:15 (R47 section) itself refers to the top-level Makefile. The material R51 claim (no test/ directory, N=0 discovered/passed) is true and independently confirmed, so this is a wording inaccuracy only.
issues.fix_suggestion: Reword to match the actual listing, e.g. 'no test/ directory; tarball contains src/ (ppx_derivers.ml/.mli), pkg/pkg.ml, Makefile, ppx_derivers.opam and dune metadata'.

issues.description: Line 5 states '结果: 见文末本轮实测（.ci-result.json exit_code 为准）', but the file contains no measured-results section (it ends at the 门禁 list, line 27), and .ci-result.json must not be committed (code style rule 24), so the promised evidence does not exist in the archive.
issues.fix_suggestion: Inline the actual measured result/output in the report or cite committed evidence (e.g. test_package output) instead of the uncommitted .ci-result.json.

summary: Independent audit of archives/p/ppx_derivers/1.2.1 against the W4 gate table finds P0=0 and P1=0, so the verdict is pass; there are 5 non-blocking findings (1xP2, 4xP3). Deception checks all pass: test_package genuinely consumes the library (test_pd.ml extends the exported extensible `deriver` type and calls register/lookup/derivers with the two claimed negative controls - unknown lookup returns None, duplicate register raises - and test_ohos_e2e.ml performs real file I/O, serializing the registry to a file and re-verifying after read-back, with test.sh asserting 6/6 artifacts and matching the success banners); the sha256 b6595ee1...73b95 was independently confirmed against opam-repository metadata for the official GitHub archive; the upstream v1.2.1 tree has no test/ directory, so the R51 N=0 claim is truthful; there is no #ifdef __OHOS__/-D__OHOS__, no committed binaries, no file:// URL, the source URL is the official github.com repo, manifest status 'built' is consistent with notes.md, and MANIFEST.yml assertion_count=7 matches the 4 check() + 3 fail() assertions in the .ml files. The only substantive recipe defect is the Conan-1.x `env_info` call in package_info() (P2, silent no-op under Conan 2), with the remaining P3s being style/documentation nits (method ordering, missing pipefail, R51 wording, dangling result reference in test-report.md).
